text:
sophie: Hey team, I'm in London next weekend and thinking Covent Garden brunch  who has fav spots for pastries vs sit-down brunch?
reza: Dominique Ansel is pastry heaven but expect a queue.
emily: The Ivy Market Grill is great for a calmer sit-down, reservations recommended.
owen: Gail's on Long Acre for a quick, excellent croissant and takeaway.
sophie: Any vegan/GF recs in that area?
reza: Farm Girl Cafe does GF pancakes and lots of veg options.
emily: Blind Deli on Floral St has nice gluten-free savoury tarts.
sophie: Poll time  react with emoji: :croissant: for pastries (Dominique/Gail's), :plate_with_cutlery: for sit-down (Ivy/Farm Girl), :leafy_green: for GF/vegan-focused (Farm Girl/Blind Deli).
mccafe-bot: Poll created  react to vote. (auto)
owen: :croissant:
reza: :plate_with_cutlery:
emily: :leafy_green:
sophie: :leafy_green: (leaning GF tonight)
mccafe-bot: Reminder set for Sat 09:30  "Sophie Covent Garden brunch".
sophie: Thanks everyone  I'll book Ivy for 9:30 if pastries don't win by Friday.
